name: GIGABYTE Gaming A16 GA6H CVH i7 13620H RTX 5060 8GB Gaming Laptop
shortDescription: GIGABYTE Gaming A16 GA6H CVH Gaming Laptop (Intel Core i7-13620H 10-Core Processor / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7 / 16GB DDR5 RAM / 1TB M.2 NVMe PCIe Gen4 SSD / 16-inch WUXGA 1920x1200 16:10 165Hz IPS Display / MUX
descriptionHtml:
GIGABYTE Gaming A16 GA6H CVH Gaming Laptop (Intel Core i7-13620H 10-Core Processor / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7 / 16GB DDR5 RAM / 1TB M.2 NVMe PCIe Gen4 SSD / 16-inch WUXGA 1920x1200 16:10 165Hz IPS Display / MUX Switch Technology / WINDFORCE Cooling System / 1-Zone RGB Backlit Keyboard / 76Wh Battery / 2 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Unlock elite gaming and heavy workstation performance with the GIGABYTE Gaming A16 GA6H (Model: A16 CVH) laptop, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 2-Year Local Agent Warranty. Powered by the 13th Gen Intel Core i7-13620H processor featuring 10 cores and 16 threads, paired with the powerful NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 8GB GDDR7 graphics card, this 16-inch gaming powerhouse executes smooth gameplay and high-speed rendering. Enhanced with a 165Hz WUXGA (1920x1200) 16:10 IPS display, MUX Switch technology, dual-fan WINDFORCE cooling, 16GB DDR5 memory, a fast 1TB NVMe Gen4 SSD, and a 76Wh battery, it provides maximum reliability in a premium Black Steel finish.
